registered_zenodo_ensemble.corpus: More than 22 million scRNA or snRNA cells from declared SCimilarity, brain, skin, and retina collections; Borzoi initialization; fixed 8856 output tasks
registered_zenodo_ensemble.reason: The original preprint predates GSE289173 and the declared sources do not name it, but the first read-only weight record follows the GEO release and a checkpoint-bound sample manifest is unavailable.

separate_huggingface_safetensors.checkpoint_identity: Genentech/decima-model@bd12cada26a69c54f223791e1072ab76a3ffe7b4 rep0 through rep3 safetensors with frozen LFS SHA-256 values
separate_huggingface_safetensors.rule: A converted or repackaged checkpoint cannot improve the registered checkpoint's exposure class and is a separate artifact until parity is established.

downstream_demo_resolution.rule: This published eQTL evaluation makes the task family downstream-demo evidence but does not expose GSE289173 outcomes.

input_eligibility.gse281364: Retrospective gene-linked MPRA direction and rank diagnostic after artifact admission and a development-frozen gene and task mapping.
input_eligibility.gse289173: DNA plus a frozen gene mask can be scored. Single-nucleus RNA is unused because Decima cannot accept a query expression context. Predictions are donor-invariant at an identical allele, gene, mask, and fixed task.
input_eligibility.gse296875: Static gene-centered sequence comparator only. Same-nucleus RNA and ATAC do not define new Decima tasks.
input_eligibility.observed_context_requirement: none_supported; query context is selected from the fixed 8856-task catalog

interpretation: Decima is provisionally target-label-unexposed for GSE289173 and has a native signed gene-expression VEP. It is not yet eligible for the primary held-back endpoint because the exact 8856-task metadata has not been acquired or crosswalked to all four required liver lineages. Its noncommercial code and Zenodo weight terms also make it ineligible as a best openly licensed model.
